2850.translation: Because sample size no enough, make we treat this result as temporary conclusion.

2851.translation: Expectation rise say if dem relax rules, more new firms go enter.

2852.translation: That report fit find am hard to escape criticism say e overrate policy results.

2853.translation: Dem interpret this event as different factors working together, no be only one cause.

2854.translation: If discussion scope widen, worry dey say main issue fit become less clear instead.

2855.translation: Some researchers argue say different minimum wages by region fit bring jobs back to smaller regions. Dem say lower labour cost go help small businesses hire more people. This reasoning get some basis. But wider wage gap fit make more young people leave for capital region and reduce local workers. If nobody remain to work, new jobs no go get filled. So different rates worth considering only when measures to stop population leaving dey ready at same time.

2856.translation: Government agencies still dey refuse information requests by claiming personal-data protection. Nobody dispute say personal information matter. But if document fit become public after hiding names or addresses, hiding everything look more like avoiding responsibility. Keeping information secret should be exception. Agency wey apply exception must show why e necessary. Issue no be only disclose or hide, but which parts need covering.

2857.translation: Research institute announce say students wey skip breakfast get lower grades. People then spread claim say breakfast raise grades. Survey show say two things move together. But to prove cause, dem need remove other explanations like family situation and sleep time. This survey no control those factors. So e show correlation only and no yet give enough basis for policy to recommend breakfast.

2858.translation: People widely accept preserving original form during cultural-heritage restoration. Concern say new material for damaged parts fit blur historical authenticity make sense too. But if insisting on original material mean neglecting building wey dey collapse, the object itself go disappear. Authenticity no only come from old material; clear disclosure of restored parts matter too. So restore as much as necessary and record those parts distinctly.

2859.translation: Local government finish housing-subsidy trial and announce beneficiary satisfaction above 90 percent. Feeling say subsidy help get value. But satisfaction show beneficiaries feelings; e no directly measure whether housing stability improve. Calling programme success without objective measures, like number of moves or rent arrears, too early. Dem fit wait to confirm these indicators before deciding expansion.

2860.translation: Sunset system dey give regulations expiry date. People value am because unnecessary regulations no go just remain forever. Automatic expiry force responsible department to reconsider need. But if safety regulations expire mechanically too, protection gaps fit harm citizens. To achieve system aim, how strictly dem review extension should depend on regulation type, instead of one standard for everything.

2861.translation: Some believe say box-office result guarantee work value. Plenty viewers choosing am na important signal. But promotion size and screen number also affect attendance, so attendance no directly measure artistic quality. Better judgment fit compare audience response under similar conditions and whether word of mouth last. So box-office success na starting point for evaluation, no be final answer.

2862.translation: According to Statistics Korea, one-person household share reach record high this year.

2863.translation: News and editorials dey use plain written style instead of polite spoken style, with fixed reporting patterns.

2864.translation: Government plan increase electric-car subsidies from next year.

2865.translation: Experts predict say economic recovery go slow.

2866.translation: Journalists use fixed endings wey mean expected, likely or forecast to describe expectations.

2867.translation: For this survey, 60 percent of respondents say system need improvement.

2868.translation: Reporting verbs like announce, point out and reveal dey join reported clause with quotation ending.

2869.translation: Prices don rise for two months straight, so ordinary people burden dey grow.

2870.translation: Environmental groups don come out strongly against development plan.

2871.translation: After this accident, e be like say safety inspections go become even stricter.

2872.translation: Labour and management disagreement over wage increase dey deepen.

2873.translation: Because exports strong, dem revise this year economic-growth forecast upward.

2874.translation: As controversy start, company release official apology.

2876.translation: Official reveal say dem never decide detailed schedule.

2879.translation: Time wey teenagers spend on smartphone dey increase every year.

2880.translation: Because of that, city hall decide to begin traffic control next week.

2881.translation: Worry dey grow say economic downturn go last long.

2882.translation: Citizens get mixed reactions to new policy.

2883.translation: Opposition-party cooperation necessary for this bill to pass.

2884.translation: Strong calls dey for full investigation to find truth about incident.

2885.translation: Government must act responsibly to regain public trust.

2886.translation: We think say this decision too early.

2887.translation: This reorganisation go get big effect throughout the industry.

2888.translation: Before government raise taxes, e must convince the public.

2892.translation: Research institute survey 1,000 office workers. Among respondents wey experience work from home, 68 percent say job satisfaction rise. But 42 percent say team communication reduce. Institute analyse say to get the benefits well, dem need communication methods like regular video meetings.

2893.translation: Notice: City-library repair work. Reading rooms go close temporarily for two weeks, from March 4 reach March 17. During this same period, book borrowing and return still available as usual for first-floor information desk. Abeg, bear with construction noise and inconvenience.

2894.translation: Recently, more residents dey call for dog-only areas inside city parks. District office decide to set up two trial areas within this year. Dem go check rule violations and complaint numbers before deciding expansion. But some residents oppose am because of noise and cleanliness concerns.

2895.translation: Some local governments dey compete to announce how much park land dem create. But area alone no mean better quality of life. Even large green space for hard-to-reach outskirts fit no serve daily needs. Success should depend on how many citizens enjoy park near home, no be just land size. As long as policy remain numbers competition, criticism say na show-off administration go remain.

2896.translation: Study analyse flexible working hours for 320 small and medium firms around capital region. Firms wey adopt am get average employee-turnover drop of 3.1 percentage points. But link with sales growth no statistically clear. Sample favour certain industries, so result no easy to generalise. Future research need test am again across different industries and firm sizes.

2897.translation: Government decide to increase low-birth-rate response budget step by step from next year. Unlike earlier plans, this one move away from cash support and focus on childcare facilities. Government judge say childbirth payments alone no fit solve childcare burden and difficulty combining work with family. So more than half of budget go expand daycare centres and after-school care.

2898.translation: Idea say language no only hold thoughts but shape how we think don dey for long time. Na linguistic-relativity hypothesis. Recent studies generally accept moderate version instead of strong version: language fit slightly affect how quickly person notice categories or where attention go. In other words, language fit influence thinking tendencies without fully determining thought.

2899.translation: After local hospital announce say e go stop night care, residents continue protest. Hospital mention staff shortage and losses. But if night service disappear, older people wey no get easy transport go suffer first. We no fit completely deny hospital financial reasoning. Still, e necessary to ask whether profit alone should judge healthcare wey serve public. Na why local-government support measures need follow too.
